title: Section 54 & Proviso: Exemption for Two Residential Houses
subject: DT
provision_raw: Section 54: Purchase/construction of residential house. Exempt = Lower of Capital Gain or Cost of New Asset. Purchase: 1 yr before or 2 yrs after transfer; Construction: 3 yrs after. Section 54 Proviso: Capital Gain <= 2 Crore (Once-in-a-lifetime) Exemption available for Two residential houses in India. Aggregate investment across both houses is eligible.
story_summary: Ramesh sells his ancestral residential villa in Kochi, making a Long-Term Capital Gain of ₹1.8 Crore. Since his capital gain does not exceed ₹2 Crore, he avails the special once-in-a-lifetime proviso under Section 54 to reinvest in two smaller residential apartments (₹90 Lakhs & ₹70 Lakhs). We analyze his timeline, aggregate cost aggregation, exemption computation, and final taxable capital gain.

slides.slide_title: Original Transfer: Sale of Residential Property
slides.scene_purpose: Establish the initial transfer of the original long-term residential house property.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Namaskaram students! Section 54 study cheyyumpol first step asset identity aanu. Nammude Ramesh Kochiyilulla ttante ancestral residential house sale cheythu. Buyer Anithayude kayyil ninnu ₹3.5 Crore Sale Consideration received. Cost of acquisition after indexation deduct cheythal Net Long Term Capital Gain varunnath ₹1.8 Crore aanu.

slots.title: Transfer of Original Asset (Sec 54)
slots.note: Section 54 applies only when the original asset transferred is a long-term residential house property.

slides.scene_purpose: Verify if Ramesh qualifies for the once-in-a-lifetime concession of investing in TWO residential houses.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Normally Section 54 ill ORE ORO residential house-il investment mathramayirunnu allowed. Pakshe Section 54 proviso nokiye! Transfer cheytha property-yude Net Capital Gain ₹2 Crore-il thazheyaaneil, assessee-ku 2 residential houses-il investment cheyanullha once-in-a-lifetime option und. Nammude Ramesh-inte gain ₹1.8 Crore ayathukond door swing open aayi!

slots.title: Proviso Eligibility: Two Houses Option

conditions.text: Original Asset is a Long-Term Residential House
Option exercised ONCE in a lifetime

slots.note: Proviso to Sec 54 allows investment in 2 residential houses in India if Capital Gain <= ₹2 Crore.

slides.scene_purpose: Check whether the new houses are purchased within the statutory timeline (1 yr before or 2 yrs after transfer).
slides.dialogue_manglish: Timeline correct aano? Transfer date ninnu 2 years-innullil purchase cheyyanam, le? Ramesh transfer cheythu 14 months-innullil 2 new residential apartments buy cheythu. 2-year statutory limit-innu ullil thanne transaction complete ayathukond timeline test completely passed!

slots.title: Purchase Timeline Window (Sec 54)
slots.note: For purchase: 1 year before or 2 years after transfer date. Construction: 3 years after.

slides.scene_purpose: Fuse the cost of Flat A and Flat B into one combined aggregate investment value under the proviso.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Section 54 proviso prakaram Ramesh 2 residential houses-il invest cheythu. Apartment A cost ₹90 Lakhs and Apartment B cost ₹70 Lakhs. Ernakulathilulla ee 2 flats-inte cost merge cheythu Aggregate Investment in New Assets ₹1.6 Crore aayi calculate cheyyunnu.

slots.title: Aggregate Investment in Two Houses
slots.note: Under the Sec 54 proviso, aggregate cost of both residential houses in India is eligible.

slides.scene_purpose: Apply the core statutory benchmark rule: Exemption = Lower of Capital Gain vs Cost of New Asset(s).
slides.dialogue_manglish: Ini Section 54 Exemption Amount ethrayaane thirichariyanam. Statute plain english-il parayunnu: Lower of Capital Gain OR Cost of New Assets. Nammude Capital Gain ₹1.8 Crore, Total Cost of 2 New Houses ₹1.6 Crore. Evide LOWER amount aaya ₹1.6 Crore aanu exemption aayi claim cheyyan pattukayu!

slots.title: Quantum of Exemption (Sec 54)
slots.note: Exemption is strictly capped at the lower of Capital Gain or aggregate investment cost.

slides.scene_purpose: Deduct the Section 54 exemption from original LTCG to determine final taxable income.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Final calculation nokoo! Net LTCG of ₹1.8 Crore ninnu Section 54 Exemption of ₹1.6 Crore subtract cheyumbol, Ramesh taxable LTCG aayi pay cheyyendath verum ₹20 Lakhs mathram aanu. Huge tax relief!

slots.title: Net Taxable Capital Gain Result
slots.note: Taxable LTCG = Original LTCG - Sec 54 Exemption = ₹20,00,000.

slides.scene_purpose: Summarize the critical legal rules of Section 54 Proviso for exam recall.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Exam-innu mindil vekkenda core statutory point ithaanu: Section 54 proviso prakaram Capital Gain ₹2 Crore-il thazheyanengil assessee-ku 2 Residential Houses-il invest cheythu exemption claim cheyyam — pakshe ee option life-il ONCE mathrame labhickoo!

slots.title: Section 54 Proviso Core Principle
slots.statement: If Capital Gain does not exceed ₹2 Crore, assessee can claim Sec 54 exemption for TWO residential houses in India once in a lifetime.
slots.support_line: Aggregate investment eligible | Purchase: 1 yr before / 2 yrs after | Construction: 3 yrs
